newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Hold contracting bias.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Hold contracting bias.

text.p: Australian bonds showed an outperforming bias against the dollar bloc amid continued expectations of a easing in monetary policy, although today's spread contraction occured in a very slim local turnover.

The market will be on alert for a policy announcement by the Reserve Bank all this week, but such a move is being seen as more likely after the policy making meetings in both Australia and the U.S. next week.

"The fundamentals suggest that the domestic market has the potential to outperform to around 30 basis points in the near term, supported by expectations of another rate cut," said Su-Lin Ong, fixed income economist at Hambros Bank Australia.
